crossRefs.note: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was…
and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh…
So Samuel called to Yahweh; and Yahweh sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared Yahweh and…
All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of…
Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by…
My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious;
for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: On that day, Yahweh magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
translations.bsb: On that day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they revered him all the days of his life, just as they had revered Moses.
translations.kjv: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
translations.asv: On that day Jehovah magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
